ProjectWorkspaceInboxDispatchAction.description: The exact action a proposal asks the user to authorize.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxDispatchContext.description:
Bounded routing context for the suggestion Agent. It intentionally carries
no transcripts or Page bodies other than the entries being considered. For a
Project's Inbox, Projects and chats are narrowed to that Project.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxDispatchWork.description: A confirmed dispatch that the Desktop Host must deliver.

final_text.description: None only for pre-snapshot history that must be reconciled, never sent.

images.description:
Bindings to the reviewed Library image bytes, in marker order. Delivery must read
bytes matching content_hash or mark the image unavailable; File heads may change.

thread_backend_kind.description: Runtime family of the target chat's Thread: codex, claude, opencode, or acp.

oneOf.description: Current status of the target chat's Thread, used to wait until it is idle.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxEntryKind.description:
User-editable classification of what an Inbox entry is. It never implies
that work is authorized.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxEntryState.description: Triage state chosen by the user. Execution state lives on proposals.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxImportantMessage.description: An important message still waiting in its Inbox, as the stream points back to it.

title.description: The Page title: the sender's own, or the name the suggestion Agent gave it.

oneOf.description: Present for an Automation's decision.

body.description:
The message as the stream shows it, in Nodex Markdown: the Page body when it
fits the stream budget, otherwise the opening of its text as paragraphs.

body_editable.description:
The stream shows the whole body and it still has the message shape, text followed
by images, so the user can rewrite it in place. Other bodies are edited as their Page.

important.description: The user marked the message important, so it stays in view while it waits.

oneOf.description:
Still in its Inbox's home Database: the Library Inbox Database, or the
Project's own Database for a Project's Inbox.
Filed or moved into another Database.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxLocation.description: Where a message's Page lives, relative to the Inbox that received it.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxMessageEdit.description:
The Page write that rewrites one message, prepared by Core's message rules so
an edit reads exactly like a message sent with the same text.

basis.description: The Page state the write must still apply to.

body_markdown.description: The new body, or None when the text did not change.

title_markdown.description: The new provisional title, only while the title is still provisional.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxMessageImage.description: One Library image referenced by a message, in body reading order.

content_hash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the Library's stored bytes.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxOutcome.description: Product decision, independent of the Page's current location.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxPageBasis.description: Fingerprint of the exact Page-body Markdown and ordered Library image content hashes.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxPageStatus.description: The message Page's current workflow Status option and display name.

basis.description: Current member fingerprints, fenced when the user confirms.

oneOf.description: Current state of the chat named by `send_to_chat`, or the dispatched chat.

created_page_ids.description: Created cards in plan-step order; empty until confirmation.

outdated.description: Any current member text differs from the text this advice was written from.

target_project_name.description: Display context for the action's target Project.

oneOf.description: The Library Inbox, for thoughts whose Project is not known yet.
All Projects, including messages without a Project.
A Project's own Inbox. Its messages are Pages in the Project's Database.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxScope.description:
Which Inbox owns an entry's decision. It is fixed at capture and does not follow
the Page: a message filed into another Project stays in its own Inbox's History.

run_id.description: The captured causal Run; absent when the native protocol cannot identify one.

oneOf.description: Sent through the `nodex` command line, optionally from inside a Project.
A due decision of an Automation that asks before it runs.

label.description: The task's name when the decision arrived.

ProjectWorkspaceInboxSuggestionInput.description: One entry the suggestion Agent should consider, with bounded content.

body.description: Exact body Markdown with numbered Library image markers.

title_provisional.description: The Page still has Core's provisional title, so the suggestion Agent may name it.

database_id.description: The Database new messages of this Inbox become Pages in, once it exists.

important.description:
The longest-waiting important messages still in the Inbox, oldest first, so one
out of view can be found without loading the stream back to it.

important_count.description: Important messages still in the Inbox.

inbox_count.description: Messages still in the Inbox; the user's goal is to bring this to zero.

An application command retaining its authenticated execution provenance.

initial_page_ids.description: Explicit Page hand-offs: link atomically and advance Triage/Plan to in progress.

oneOf.description:

The admitted Agent choice; execution remains unavailable until the Host observes it.

coordinator.description: Host-only role binding, atomic with Session/execution admission.

initial_page_ids.description: Explicit Page hand-offs: link atomically and advance Triage/Plan to in progress.

initial_page_ids.description: Explicit Page hand-offs: link atomically and advance Triage/Plan to in progress.

oneOf.description: Opens a root Codex conversation without transferring execution ownership.
Applies metadata only while the observed native conversation binding remains current.
Admits one existing native conversation without creating or replaying Agent messages.
Host acknowledges execution settlement only for the exact durable cleanup identity.

Captures one message as a Page. A Library Inbox message becomes a Page in the
Inbox Database, created on first use; a Project Inbox message becomes a Page in
that Project's Database. Agent provenance, when present, becomes immutable source.
The body is message text with the message shape, text followed by images, and
becomes the Page body as canonical Nodex Markdown. Without a sender title, Core gives the Page a provisional
title that the suggestion Agent may later replace.

project_id.description:
The Project whose Inbox receives the message. Only the Desktop Host chooses;
an Agent Turn uses its own Project and the command line its bound Project.

oneOf.description:
Erases messages the user wants gone. Their entries and every suggestion naming them
leave now; each Page is tombstoned with all its revisions so Store maintenance
collects what remains. Only Pages still in their own Inbox's Database qualify.
Records one suggestion for current entry content. It never authorizes work.
The user authorizes one exact proposal revision, optionally with edits.
The user authors and authorizes a dispatch without a suggestion.
Keeps entries open without acting on their current suggestions.
Only the user marks a message important; a suggestion never does.
Reconciles advice lifecycle and admits or clears sends awaiting automatic advice.

Records that the user rewrote a message. Suggestions made for the old text are
withdrawn and every message they covered waits for a new one; a provisional
title follows the new opening words.
Records successful host delivery of a confirmed chat dispatch.

Places a held Ask first decision in the Inbox with its editable action text and a generic
`ExecuteDecision` proposal. Later occurrences append to the waiting decision.
The hold lease settles in the same commit. Only the Desktop Host produces decisions.

title.description: The message title, formatted by the Host in the user's time zone.

oneOf.description: Refreshes the waiting decision's message while its text remains unedited.
Claude preferences; other native runtimes retain their options separately.

runtime_session_ids.description: The most recently updated linked Runtime-bound Sessions, bounded, for live status.

working_count.description: Native thread status only; Runtime-bound Sessions report live status outside Core.

default_database_view_id.description:
Current default View of the Project's primary Database, resolved from
Database authority at read time. `None` only when the Database has no
active default View.

ProjectWorkspaceSessionExecutionRef.description: Immutable execution coordinates; presentation and execution state come from the runtime.

ProjectWorkspaceSessionSidebarPlacement.description: Durable placement for joining bounded live activity without loading Session rows.

ProjectWorkspaceSessionStart.description: A chat its Inbox decision has not started yet, with the reason it could not.

page_id.description: The Inbox message the chat was started from.

proposal_id.description: The decision that starts this chat; retrying sends it again.

retryable.description: Core would start it again now; any Member who reads the chat may retry it.

can_manage.description:
The reader may manage this chat: rename, archive or restore it, move it, compact or clear
its context and merge it back. They started it, or they own the Space.

can_stop.description:
The reader may stop the chat's current work, its subagents and tasks included: they may
manage it, or they asked for its current Run.

ProjectWorkspaceSidebarSectionOrderItem.description: An observed direct placement, supplied in its requested final order.

ProjectWorkspaceSubagentStatusEvidencePr.description: Optional compare-and-set guard for observations derived from an asynchronous remote read.

ProjectWorkspaceThreadBackendSession.description:
Durable Agent session identity, separate from backend instance settings.

native_home.description: Runtime-owned history scope: a native Profile or an external server identity.

oneOf.description: Host-observed native facts; transcript content remains owned by the Agent.

Present for Agent Runtime executions, whose engine coordinates are used verbatim.
Core validates them against the bound Session on every use and persists nothing per Run.

admitted_at_ms.description: Stable admission timestamp; execution identity carries no content permissions.

persisted.description:
Core holds a durable record of this Turn. Agent Runtime authorities are derived from their
Session binding and never persisted.

ProjectionScopeKey.description:
One projection scope transition. Revisions are per scope and advance in the
same transaction as the mutation. `covered_commit_seq` is a floor, not a
replacement for the scope revision.

ProjectionSnapshotAuthority.description:
Exact causal coordinate returned with a canonical projection snapshot.
`covered_commit_seq` records the durable read floor reached by the
snapshot; ordering within the projection is owned by `revision`.

PushPreferences.description: What a phone wants to hear from this Space, in the phone RPC's own field names.

PushRegistration.description:
Where a Device receives notifications: an opaque relay handle and the base64url key that seals
them. Both stay between the phone, Core and the local Host.

RecoveryBundleManifest.description: NDRB v1 has a 12-byte header followed by this manifest and ordered sections.

source.description: Lossless source envelope, including original request identities. Never replayed with new IDs.

RecoveryEvidenceReference.description: References live outside source JSON, so arbitrary user fields remain unambiguous.

expected_payload_sha256.description: Original recorded digest, retained for diagnosing damaged payloads.

external_files.description: File contents are external dependencies, not embedded backups.

RecoveryExportRequest.description: Export preserves payload bytes and the File dependency snapshot without decoding content.

RemoteAccessIntent.description: Profile-owned remote listener preference, restored by Core at startup.

RemoteBudget.description: The independently bounded resource which refused remote admission.

RemotePrincipal.description: Space membership proven by a renewable, device-bound session.

RenameMemberRequest.description: The name other Members see for the requesting Member; never the relative word "You".

ResourceKey.description: Exact resource vocabulary used for delivery routing and projection invalidation.

SessionMemberActions.description:
A chat's Runs as the reading Member may act on them, from Core's own records. Whether they may

Whether the reader may stop this Run's work, its subagents and tasks: they asked for the

SpaceKind.description: Core-owned Space kind, independent of listener activation or hosting mode.

SpaceName.description: Display identity belongs to Core; endpoints remain transport coordinates.

StreamCheckpoint.description:
Proof that Core's durable scanner inspected the ledger through a sequence.
Commit sequences are monotonic and unique but need not be contiguous.
